subject: Request: Approval for Support & Integration Concession — MedBatch SRE Bundle
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@medbatch.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Cc: Joan Park <joan.park@medbatch.com>, procurement@medbatch.com
Date: 2027-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SRE bundle — request for premium support + integration scope adjustment

Rafael,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We are ready to move forward but need two concessions to make the budget work: 1) include Premium Support (24/7, Priority) for the first 12 months bundled into the enterprise price, and 2) add a fixed scope of custom integration work to support our on-call tooling (estimated 40 engineer-hours).

MedBatch is comfortable with the annual committed spend, but the internal procurement team requires either a product credit or a one-time discount for the integration work to avoid approving a separate SOW. Can you confirm whether Redwood can bundle the premium support for year one and absorb the integration effort as a partial concession?

If this needs exec signoff, please let us know what you need from our side. We can provide the PO within 48 hours once terms are agreed.

—Elena
Elena Torres
Director, Platform Engineering | MedBatch
From: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@medbatch.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-11-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SRE bundle — request for premium support + integration scope adjustment

Elena —

We can move quickly on this. High-level ask: bundle Premium Support for 12 months (no charge) + cover 40 engineer-hours of custom integration into the initial onboarding SOW. These are out-of-box concessions for our standard enterprise terms and exceed our standard discount playbook, so I need an exec approval from Deal Desk / Revenue Leadership.

Summarizing proposed concession:
- Premium Support (Priority, 24/7) included free for first 12 months
- 40 hours of custom integration included in onboarding SOW (onshore engineers; travel not included)
- One-time onboarding fee reduced by 35% to offset the integration allocation

We have the PO timing you mentioned. I'll escalate internally and aim to get a decision within the day. If leadership approves, we will route an amended SOW and DocuSign link this afternoon.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-11-01T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: SRE bundle — request for premium support + integration scope adjustment

Rafael — forwarding. Given the concession size (35% onboarding reduction + free year of premium support + 40 hrs engineering) this needs explicit approval from Revenue Ops + VP. Karthik, can you weigh in on whether we have margin headroom and if Legal will accept absorbing the integration scope into the primary SOW (no separate MSA/SOW)?

Quick notes:
- Customer is mid-market; strategic for our medtech GTM in Q1.
- They asked for no travel; integration should be remote.
- Finance flagged that anything >30% discount or equivalent must be signed off at VP level.

If we get a green light, we'll prepare a clean SOW (SOW_v2) with tracked redlines for Legal.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-11-01T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SRE bundle — request for premium support + integration scope adjustment

Team —

I reviewed the economics in RB_CostBreakdown_MB_v3.xlsx and spoke briefly with Finance. Given the strategic fit and predictable ARR, I approve the concession under the following conditions:
1) Discount cap: discount/concession value must not exceed the margin impact modeled in tab 'NetEffect' (I verified current sheet).
2) Premium Support: include free Premium for first 12 months, then auto-convert to standard paid support unless revoked in writing.
3) Integration hours: include up to 40 remote hours; any overages billed at standard T&M. Add acceptance criteria for the integration work in SOW (deliverables, owner, timeline).
4) Legal: we will not accept open-ended integration obligations. Legal needs the redlined SOW (attached) signed before PO acceptance.

Kudos Rafael — good close. Marissa, confirm with Legal and Finance that the NetEffect tab is final. Once those are confirmed, Rafael can send the amended SOW + DocuSign for Elena.

—Karthik Iyer
VP, Revenue | Redwood Inference
From: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@medbatch.com>, procurement@medbatch.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-11-01T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Approved: Amended SOW & next steps for MedBatch (DB-58421-MB)

Elena —

Good news: Revenue has approved the requested concessions with conditions. Summary of the approved package (for clarity):
- Premium Support (Priority, 24/7) included at no charge for the first 12 months; thereafter standard support pricing applies.
- Up to 40 hours of remote custom integration included as part of onboarding; overages billed at standard T&M rates.
- Onboarding fee reduced by 35% in recognition of the bundled integration scope.
- Legal will include explicit acceptance criteria and a cap on open-ended integration work in the amended SOW.

Next steps:
1) I have attached the amended SOW (MedBatch_SOW_v2.pdf) with tracked changes.
2) Legal will require a signature on the redlined SOW prior to us provisioning the free premium support.
3) I will send a DocuSign link once Laura confirms the redlines are in order.

If you can confirm acceptance of these conditions, we'll generate the final DocuSign today and aim to kick off onboarding next week.

Thanks — excited to get MedBatch onboarded.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@medbatch.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@medbatch.com, joan.park@medbatch.com
Date: 2027-11-02T15:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Approved: Amended SOW & next steps for MedBatch (DB-58421-MB)

Rafael —

This looks good and within the parameters the procurement committee needed. We accept the conditions and will review the redlined SOW. Please route the DocuSign when the SOW is finalized; procurement will issue the PO within 24–48 hours of signature.

One quick ask: could you include a named technical owner (Redwood Integration Lead) in the SOW so our SRE team has a single contact during handoff? If possible, list the engineer/resource level rather than a specific person.

Thanks,
—Elena
Elena Torres
Director, Platform Engineering | MedBatch
